skills.name: Summoner's Ritual
lines: Stack 2 Dragon Origins on user and Attack all enemies with damage based on Spirit (upper limit: 70, Max Damage: 10,000) (ignores target's defense)
* Restores all Statuses on user, give Status immunity to user (1 time) and Restore 30 MP
* Dragon Origin: MP Consumption of skills reduced based on number of orbs stacked (max stack: 4)
* Extra Spirit gained/reduced from battle doesn't change this skill damage
** (Example: Yipha AS Faith or Milsha AS Sacrifice lunatic song)

abilities.name: PWR and SPD Buff - Earth St. - Ea.
abilities.page: PWR and SPD Buff - Earth St. - Ea.
lines: When in Torn Earth Stance: Increases PWR and SPD of all allies +7.5% \ +15% \ +22.5% \ +30% (1 turn)
* effect's power is based on number ( 1 \ 2 \ 3 \ 4 ) of Earth type moves used during the turn.
** double moves from Copy status are counted twice. Attack again moves are each counted.
** End-of-Turn, counters, knocked back or dead allies' moves are not counted.
** Counting Rules - in-length explanations
